collection_thesis: A surreal, human-centered series about the traces people leave behind when their voices, places and routines disappear.
relationship_to_genesis: A thematic companion to The Witness, not a visual sequel. Keep the sense of mystery and symbolic storytelling while avoiding reuse of its eye, ornate frame or empty-landscape composition.
creative_guardrails: Create original compositions; do not imitate a living artist or reproduce a known artwork.
Do not use copyrighted characters, brand marks, celebrity likenesses or recognizable franchise designs.
Avoid generic AI gloss, random decorative clutter, fake signatures, watermarks and embedded text.
Each artwork must have one memorable visual metaphor and a clear focal point.
Do not claim that a concept is trending or commercially validated without sourced demand evidence.

concepts.core_question: What remains when a place has nobody left to speak?
concepts.emotional_tension: Abandonment versus the stubborn possibility of connection.
concepts.visual_metaphor: An antique shortwave radio half-buried in a black salt plain, with a single delicate green shoot emerging from its speaker grille.
concepts.composition: Low, cinematic three-quarter view; radio occupies the lower-right third; vast negative space and a thin horizon; one tiny distant light.
concepts.material_language: Weathered bakelite, salt crystals, oxidized metal, fragile living leaf.
concepts.narrative: The machine no longer receives a human voice, yet something living answers from inside it.
concepts.distinctiveness_rule: Do not include eyes, ornate gold frames or human legs; the radio and the emerging shoot must carry the entire metaphor.

concepts.core_question: Can a map remember a destination that was never reached?
concepts.emotional_tension: Hope versus the grief of an unfinished journey.
concepts.visual_metaphor: A monumental folded paper atlas floating just above a dark, perfectly still sea; its contour lines slowly transform into constellations.
concepts.composition: Top-down perspective with a strong diagonal fold; the atlas is centered but surrounded by deep water; delicate stars appear only along the map lines.
concepts.material_language: Handmade archival paper, graphite contours, translucent water, pinprick starlight.
concepts.narrative: A journey that never happened leaves behind a geography of its own.
concepts.distinctiveness_rule: No radio, no plant, no eye imagery; the paper fold and transforming map lines are the signature.

concepts.core_question: If a person disappears, can their shadow remain as a witness?
concepts.emotional_tension: Presence versus absence; identity versus memory.
concepts.visual_metaphor: An empty, ordinary wooden chair in a sunless room; its shadow stands upright behind it in the shape of a person, without depicting a body.
concepts.composition: Centered frontal view with architectural symmetry; chair small in frame; the upright shadow is the dominant shape; a narrow shaft of pale light reveals dust.
concepts.material_language: Worn wood, plaster, dust, soft volumetric light and deep matte shadow.
concepts.narrative: The room has forgotten its occupant, but the shadow has not.
concepts.distinctiveness_rule: No literal human figure, no portrait, no eye or frame; the empty chair and impossible shadow must remain visually legible.
